scope: Post-study descriptive review of the consumed 2023-2025 test. No strategy tuning, new holdout or causal attribution.

interpretation.momentum_63: ML also trails momentum in the zero-cost rerun. Differential friction slightly narrows this gap, so extra trading costs alone do not explain the primary shortfall.
interpretation.equal_weight: ML trails equal weight before costs; its larger friction drag further widens that shortfall.
interpretation.sector: Differences in fund-level net dollar contributions reconcile the NAV gap. They combine differing holdings, timing and execution, and are not Brinson or causal selection effects.
interpretation.curve: Relative wealth is ML NAV divided by comparator NAV minus one; it differs from a difference of CAGRs and a sum of monthly excess returns.
